description: This file is a Java implementation of the ShoppingCartDao interface, providing data access methods for ShoppingCart entities with various retrieval operations based on different parameters such as ID, code, store, and customer.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ShoppingCartDao for accessing ShoppingCart data using JPA queries, handling retrieval and removal of shopping cart entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID, including its line items, attributes, and merchant store association.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID with merchant store details.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code, returning the first match if multiple results are found.

methods.name: getById (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID and store, ensuring the shopping cart belongs to the specified store.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by code and store, returning the first match.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes the specified ShoppingCart entity from persistence.
